issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-08ae90e5 (auto-split umbrella, R010 comment mutations). This child reconciles the three audit children's findings and lands the final state of research/specs/comment-mutation-v1.md.

Scope:
Read the verdict rollups on the three sibling audit children (label split-child, parent-beadrs-08ae90e5). Apply accepted spec-side amendments to research/specs/comment-mutation-v1.md directly on main, preserving the normative style and keeping zero 'TBD'/'open question' text. For implementation-side divergences, confirm each already has its own proposal bead labeled proposal-pending and human; do not fix code in this child. If all three children reported zero divergences, no file change is needed.

Acceptance criteria (all required to close):
1. Record a rollup on this bead via 'bead update --notes' during the dispatch listing each child's findings and its disposition (spec amended / proposal bead id / confirmed conformant). A notes write during the dispatch is required even when no file changes -- close gates reject verification-only dispatches without one.
2. If the spec file changed: run grep -ciE "tbd|open question" research/specs/comment-mutation-v1.md (must output 0), test -s research/specs/comment-mutation-v1.md, commit ONLY that file with a message citing this bead and the parent, push to origin main from main (no force-push), and confirm git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty.
3. Report the final spec commit sha, or 'unchanged', on this bead.
issue.title: Reconcile comment spec audit findings and land final spec amendments

issue.description:
ADR-001 requires inversion to be diagnosed structurally from a declared `verifies` edge (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead), reported and never rejected at insert time, with no title heuristics under any circumstance. Add an advisory doctor check that reports such pairs with issue ids and the recommended re-orientation. The check must never mutate the graph (matching the section 7 / R034 diagnose-don't-mutate posture) and can never make a bead eligible or ineligible. Tests: detector coverage over fixture graphs including two-node rings that are simultaneously a cycle and an inversion, plus an advisory-only assertion that no repair path alters edges. Depends on the `verifies` edge kind landing first.
